name: Medicine Ball Slam
steps: Cup a ball designed for slams in both hands at waist level and leave space on the floor in front of you.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as you sweep the medicine ball high overhead with extended arms and a braced core.
Drive your hips down into a partial squat while slamming the ball powerfully straight down onto the floor just in front of your feet.
Squat smoothly with a flat back to pick up the ball and transition directly into the next slam.
tips: Engage your lats, abs, and hips to power the slam instead of hunching your lower back forward.
Keep the landing spot ahead of your toes and let the ball settle before reaching for it.
